summary: Completed E2E testing of ENZI iteration 194: Bot Store/Marketplace, Meeting History Panel, and Legacy Admin User Display fix. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). All 18 frontend UI tests passed (100%). New Phase 1 features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: enzi_bots.py: Bot catalog correctly returns 8 bots with categories (Productivity, Engagement, Collaboration, Onboarding, AI, Communication, DevOps). Install/uninstall endpoints work correctly.
enzi_meetings.py: GET /lumi/meetings/history returns meetings with total count, supports limit/skip pagination. Meeting structure includes id, title, status, created_at.
BotStoreModal.jsx: Modal shows Browse/Installed tabs, 8 bot cards with icons, category filter chips, channel selector dropdown, search input. Install buttons disabled until channel selected.
MeetingHistoryPanel.jsx: Panel shows past meetings with status badges (Waiting/Scheduled/Ended), 'New Meeting' button, total count header. Correctly formatted timestamps.

UserProfileModal.jsx (lines 162-183): Auth method badges now show for ALL auth types - Google SSO, Microsoft SSO, GitHub SSO, Passkey Auth, Password Auth. Admin user correctly shows 'Password Auth' badge.
LumiMessenger.jsx (lines 997-1012): Dashboard bento tiles include Bot Store and Meeting History tiles with correct data-testid attributes.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed meetings during backend testing via quick endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 194 features verified working: 1) Bot Store/Marketplace - GET /api/lumi/bots/catalog returns 8 bots, POST /api/lumi/bots/install installs to channel, GET /api/lumi/bots/installed returns user's installed bots, DELETE /api/lumi/bots/uninstall/{id} removes bot. Frontend BotStoreModal has Browse/Installed tabs, search filters by name/description, category chips filter by category. 2) Meeting History - GET /api/lumi/meetings/history returns meetings with total count. Frontend MeetingHistoryPanel shows past meetings with status badges, 'New Meeting' button opens meeting modal. 3) Legacy Admin Auth Display - UserProfileModal shows auth_method badge for ALL auth types. Admin user with auth_method='admin' shows 'Password Auth' badge. Dashboard shows 4 action tiles: Meeting, Invite, Bot Store, Meeting History.
